summary: Discussion-sourced signals: vendor product deltas (Anthropic, Google, OpenAI), multiple security/legal incidents tied to coding/agent products, operator workflow guidance and infra debates (sandboxes, memory, evals). Prioritize vendor advisories and follow social threads for emerging exploit details. | Vendor-only feed: major vendor product releases (AWS, Mistral, OpenRouter, JetBrains, Microsoft), operator guidance (Google, JetBrains, Vercel), and infra/security primitives (E2B, Modal, GHSA advisories). Missing social/discussion corroboration. | GitHub OSS snapshot: high-traction agent platforms and major vendor changelogs plus infra building blocks (sandboxes, evals). Many repo-only signals need independent social/coverage checks. | Package-layer signals showing rising agent tooling: major vendor VS Code extensions (OpenAI), core infra agents (Amazon ECS), new sandbox/MCP/memory primitives, and security/eval tools. Mix of high-download mainstream extensions and many infra-primitive packages needing corroboration.
